scope: Existing Engineer/Soldier/Heavy specialization and four shared-technique ownership sets, plus their required foundations
limits: Every counted set contains an issued specialization and is replayed through actual canonical Game.transact from an explicitly controlled Endless encounter9/27SP lobby. These are legal build configurations, not actual earned-clear or online-room demonstrations.
